blind.description: A stylized wooden alchemy/apothecary bench featuring a double-tier back shelf loaded with corked potion bottles in white, green, red, and amber. The main desktop holds a copper alembic still with a curved condenser pipe draining into a small jar, a small wooden rack holding three round potion bottles, a set of brass balance scales, and a small shallow bowl filled with yellow powder. Beneath the tabletop, a lower shelf supports two storage jars flanking a central drawer unit.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden workbench top with a double row of small circular bottle tops along the rear, a circular copper still pot with a curved arm leading to a small flask on the left, three circular bottle tops in a rack in the center, and a brass balance scale and small circular bowl with yellow contents on the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4 to 4.5 ft tall to the top of the rear shelf (around 70-75% the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure), and roughly 4.5 to 5 ft wide.
